name: Desert Spider
art_prompt: a big hairy desert wolf spider with sandy tan and dusty brown bristly fur, a dark brown chevron pattern down the middle of its oval abdomen, long legs banded in tan and dark brown, a cluster of small glossy black eyes on the front of its head and two short dark fangs
motion: scuttling in place on its eight legs like a real spider, the legs stepping in two alternating sets of four, the body low and level
anim_negative: extra legs, nine legs, ten legs, six legs, legs merging, a leg growing from the head, antennae, a tail, wings, two heads, a second spider, standing upright
dead_hint: lying dead on its back, its eight legs curled up over its pale belly like a real dead spider
doc: Pass 92: a desert spider walked on Garry's 3D spider (made eight-legged) by the scorpion's method, four looks from near-real to very cartoony, and a death that rolls it onto its back with its legs curled up. Fire-ant numbers for now; no map brings it yet: Garry places it in the Level Editor.

SP-A.note: Near-realistic desert wolf spider (the least cartoony)

recipe.blockout: a smooth plain clay 3D model of a spider: a small head with two short fangs at the front, one big oval abdomen behind it, and eight long jointed legs, four on each side, spread round the body
recipe.prompt: a big hairy desert wolf spider with sandy tan and dusty brown bristly fur, a dark brown chevron pattern down the middle of its oval abdomen, long legs banded in tan and dark brown, a cluster of small glossy black eyes on the front of its head and two short dark fangs
recipe.detail: a real spider's anatomy and proportions, no cartoon face, no eyebrows, no mouth, no teeth, menacing
recipe.anatomy: exactly eight legs, four on each side, each leg one single continuous jointed limb that starts at the body and ends in one pointed foot, exactly one head with two short fangs, exactly one round abdomen, no antennae, no tail, no wings, no extra legs, the left and right sides symmetrical

words.front: walking straight towards the viewer, seen from the front and a little above: its head and two fangs are at the bottom middle of the picture, nearest the viewer; its two front legs reach forward towards the viewer, one on each side of the head, and its other six legs spread out to the left and the right, three on each side; the round abdomen rises behind the head
words.fd: walking towards the lower right corner of the picture, turned three-quarters towards the viewer and seen a little from above: the head with its face, both eyes and both fangs at the lower right, nearest the viewer, the round abdomen at the upper left, farther away; the two front legs reach forward towards the lower right, the other legs spread to both sides
words.bd: walking away towards the upper right corner of the picture, seen three-quarters from behind and a little above: the round abdomen nearest the viewer at the lower left, the head at the upper right, farther away, four legs on each side
words.back: walking straight away from the viewer, seen from behind and a little above: its round abdomen is nearest the viewer at the bottom middle of the picture, the head beyond it is mostly hidden, and its eight legs spread out to the left and the right, four on each side

recipe.motion: scuttling in place on its eight legs like a real spider, the legs stepping in two alternating sets of four, the body low and level
recipe.anim_negative: extra legs, nine legs, ten legs, six legs, legs merging, a leg growing from the head, antennae, a tail, wings, two heads, a second spider, standing upright
recipe.death_motion: it jerks, rolls over onto its back and lies dead with its eight legs curled up over its sandy tan belly like a real dead spider, the legs folded in towards each other, the same colours as the reference all over, nothing green
recipe.dead: lying dead on its back, its eight legs curled up over its belly
